question: Does explicitly admitted, source-guarded reuse of the immediately preceding motor intent causally reduce input-free planner-wait time in the fixed real MAP01 threat fixture without release/scorer failure or an independent negative event?
claim_scope: causal bounded-recovery mechanism under a fixed simulated 600 ms planner delay; zero model calls; not frontier-model efficacy

recovery.guard: fresh typed health required; cancel on health loss, unavailable health, or non-fresh sequence

measurement.retained_input_lower: input_ack_ns to release_call_started_ns, unioned within planner window
measurement.retained_input_upper: admitted_ns to release_call_returned_ns, unioned within planner window
measurement.independent_outcome: scorer-only progress events plus final independent score, never controller-visible

decision.hold: HOLD if safety remains intact but continuity is not improved in all three pairs or median reduction is below 10%
decision.fail: FAIL on hard measurement/release/terminal disagreement or any independent negative recovery event
decision.positive_useful_signal: retain descriptively; does not upgrade scope to frontier-model efficacy

stop_rule: retain the first workflow-path-global formal outcome; no retry under this allocation ID
prohibited: changing fixture, pair order, wait window, recovery pulse schedule, lease, source-age bound, guard, or thresholds after viewing the result
retrying this allocation after a formal outcome
next_if_pass: mechanism causal block is closed; model-integrated efficacy remains a distinct future allocation only if a model-capable execution environment is available
next_if_hold_or_fail: retain first outcome and isolate the concrete mechanism or measurement failure before any new allocation
